newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares reach new high, correction looming.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares reach new high, correction looming.

text.p: Danish share prices closed at a new record high again on Tuesday for the fourth consecutive trading day, with dealers seeing correction ahead.

"I think we are going to see a half percentage point correction in the market tomorrow with banks and Tele Danmark in focus due to the current major foreign investor interest in Danish shares," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index ended the day 0.80 point up at 150.76 in overall bourse turnover of 1.422 billion crowns. The KFX March future rose 1.10 point to 149.80 with 460 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Tele Danmark rose eight crowns to finish at 378, boosted by redundancy plans by part-owned Belgacom similar to staff cuts announced by itself last week.
Otherwise leading banks boomed on, Den Danske Bank closing 12 crowns up at 543 with rival Unidanmark ending one higher at 350 after rejecting rumours of merger plans with Sweden's Nordbanken.
